content.text:
I fixed the bug and all 4 tests now pass.

The bug was in `src/offset.js`. The README says pages are numbered from 1, but `offset` computed `page * perPage`, which only works if pages start at 0. That skipped the first five issues: `pageOf(1)` returned issues 7–3 instead of 12–8, and page 3 came back empty.

I changed it to `(page - 1) * perPage`.
